_comment: Claude Code plugin hook wiring. MUST stay behaviourally in sync with contexer/adapters/claude.py (the console-script installer) — same code paths, same guards. Only the invocation differs: the plugin runs `uv run --directory ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` (durable plugin dir) instead of sys.executable, and carries no trailing `# contexer-managed-hook` sentinel comment — that sentinel exists only so the console-script installer can recognize and migrate its own previously-installed hooks on reinstall; this static bundle never self-migrates. tests/test_plugin_hooks.py asserts this file carries no superseded anti-patterns AND drives the real installer to diff generated command content against it.

hooks.command: REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer import store; from contexer.adapters import claude as _c; import json,sys; repo=sys.argv[1]; raw=sys.stdin.read(); store.anchor_repo(repo); _c.sync_memory(repo); _c.pull_team(repo); print(json.dumps(store.get_session_start_context(repo, store.source_from_hook_stdin(raw), store.session_from_hook_stdin(raw), 'claude')))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; claude.sync_memory(sys.argv[1])" "$REPO"; echo '{}'

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.post_write(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PostToolUse", "additionalContext": "Contexer: plan approved. Capture each key decision in the plan now via update_context with created_by=plan - architecture choices, constraints, conventions, including the REASONING not just the conclusion. They are stored as PROVISIONAL (suggested), not authoritative, until implementation validates them; you will reconcile them (approve / update / ignore) at the next prompt. If update_context appears as a deferred tool, first call ToolSearch(query=select:mcp__contexer__update_context)."}}'

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; claude.sync_memory(sys.argv[1])" "$REPO"; echo '{"systemMessage": "Contexer: context compaction starting \u2014 call update_context for any decisions not yet stored. If update_context appears as a deferred tool, first call: ToolSearch(query='select:mcp__contexer__update_context')"}'

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true); if [ -n "$REPO" ]; then { printf '%s' "$REPO" > ~/.contexer/.current_repo; } 2>/dev/null || true; fi; FLAG="$HOME/.contexer/.pending_capture"; if [ -f "$FLAG" ]; then rm -f "$FLAG" 2>/dev/null || true; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "Contexer: last turn settled - reconcile decisions before continuing. (1) NEW decisions that STUCK: call update_context with the full reasoning. (2) A PROVISIONAL decision from earlier this session (e.g. from an approved plan) that HELD: approve it; that CHANGED during implementation: call update_context with the new value (it supersedes the old revision); that was ABANDONED: mark it ignored via approve_decision. (3) Do NOT store approaches you tried and reverted, and keep your own unratified proposals provisional (created_by=ai) rather than storing them as settled fact. The server deduplicates and tracks repetition. If update_context appears as a deferred tool, first call ToolSearch(query=select:mcp__contexer__update_context)."}}'; else echo '{}'; fi

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer import store; import json,sys; result=store.get_bootstrap_context_prompt(sys.argv[1], store.prompt_from_hook_stdin(sys.stdin.read())); print(json.dumps(result))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.capture_constraint(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.rationale(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.team_poll(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"

REPO=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || true) && uv run --directory "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" python -P -c "from contexer.adapters import claude; import sys; print(claude.review_nudge(sys.argv[1], sys.stdin.read()))" "$REPO"
